subject: Why we avoid booking through travel portals
summary: Booking flights through credit card portals can lead to headaches when things go wrong.
body:
Credit cards often offer extra points if you book your flight through their travel portal. It sounds like a great deal.

But when you book through a portal, the portal is your travel agent. If your flight is canceled or delayed, the airline will often tell you to contact your travel agent. The portal's customer service is rarely as fast or helpful as the airline itself.

We prefer booking directly with the airline. The peace of mind is worth more than a few extra points.
